description:
Maintenance Electrician

Company: Image Synergy Ekxplor Private Limited
Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience Required: 0 - 2 years
Salary: 18K22K a month

Company: IMAGE SYNERGY EKXPLOR PVT LTD

Location: #10, Vajarahalli, Kanakapura Main Road, Bangalore 560062

Eligibility

Qualification - ITI / Electrical & Electronics Maintenance.
Experience - 0 - 2 years of experience in electrical maintenance, preferably in a manufacturing/production units.
Salary - Based on relevant experience, skills and performance.
Job Type - Full-time

Job Responsibilities

Maintenance Electrician - Carry out preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of electrical equipment and machinery.
Troubleshoot and repair electrical faults in production machines and utility equipment.
Install, maintain, and repair motors, starters, control panels, MCC panels, distribution boards, transformers, and electrical wiring.
Diagnose problems related to contactors, relays, overloads, sensors, switches, VFDs, and control circuits.
Perform electrical maintenance of manufacturing machines and production lines.
Read and interpret electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and circuit diagrams.
Support troubleshooting of PLC-controlled machines and industrial automation systems.
Check electrical parameters such as voltage, current, insulation resistance, and continuity using appropriate testing instruments.
Conduct regular inspection of electrical installations and identify potential failures or safety hazards.
Maintain records of preventive maintenance, breakdowns, repairs, and spare parts used.
Coordinate with production and mechanical maintenance teams to minimize machine downtime.
Assist in the installation and commissioning of new electrical equipment and machinery.
Ensure compliance with electrical safety procedures, LOTO (Lockout/Tagout), PPE requirements, and company safety standards.
Maintain housekeeping and follow 5S practices in the maintenance area.
Support energy-saving initiatives and identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability.
Ensure all maintenance activities are completed safely and within the required time.

description:
We are hiring ITI-certified candidates to join our Aluminium Structural Glazing and Window Manufacturing unit as Fitters and Machine Operators. If you have experience with assembling, installing, and operating machinery or possess strong technical skills in aluminium fabrication, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

Key Responsibilities

Fitter Responsibilities

• Assemble, install, and repair aluminium glazing systems and windows.

• Use hand tools, power tools, and machines to cut, shape, and fit aluminium components.

• Read and interpret technical drawings and blueprints for accurate assembly.

• Inspect and test glazing systems and windows to ensure quality standards.

• Perform routine maintenance and repairs on tools and equipment.

Machine Operator Responsibilities

• Operate and monitor machinery used in aluminium glazing and window manufacturing, including CNC and cutting machines.

• Ensure machines produce components efficiently and meet quality standards.

• Adjust machine settings as required and troubleshoot operational issues.

• Follow safety guidelines to maintain a hazard-free workplace.

• Perform routine cleaning and basic maintenance of machinery.

Qualifications

• Education: ITI certification in Fitter, Mechanical, or Machine Operator trade.

• Experience: Previous experience in aluminium glazing or window manufacturing is preferred; fresh ITI graduates are encouraged to apply.

• Skills: Knowledge of aluminium fabrication, machine operations, and assembly processes.

• Ability to read technical drawings and blueprints.

• Strong problem-solving and attention to detail.

• Physical Abilities: Ability to stand for extended periods and lift heavy materials.

• Safety Awareness: Strict adherence to safety protocols.

Working Conditions

• Full-time, on-site position.

• Regular working hours, with occasional overtime as needed.

• Training provided for specific machinery or processes.

Salary

Competitive, based on experience and skills.

Previous experience in aluminium glazing or window manufacturing is preferred; fresh ITI graduates are encouraged to apply.

description:
ASSEMBLY FITTER

Company: Altraize
Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience Required: 2+ years

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Assembly Fitter with hands-on experience in mechanical assembly, fitting, finishing, and inspection. The ideal candidate should be able to read engineering and assembly drawings, use hand tools effectively, perform mechanical fitting activities, and ensure the final assembly meets quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

Read and interpret 2D engineering drawings and assembly drawings, with a good understanding of GD&T.
Read and understand technical manuals, work instructions, and safety warnings.
Assemble mechanical components using hand tools and equipment as per assembly drawings.
Prepare machines, workpieces, tools, and auxiliaries for assembly activities.
Repair and troubleshoot malfunctioning mechanical systems.
Perform deburring, manual drilling, hand tapping, grinding, chamfering, and filing operations.
Carry out soldering and other basic assembly-related operations as required.
Operate laser engraving machines for component identification/marking.
Perform buffing and finishing of components.
Follow standard assembly processes and work instructions.
Conduct quality checks during the assembly process and inspect the final product.
Perform basic electrical wiring for fixtures where required.
Complete and maintain assembly checklists and production records.
Check, clean, and maintain tools and equipment used during assembly.
Follow QMS, 5S, and workplace safety requirements.
Work effectively with other fitters and cross-functional teams, especially during large-scale projects.
Maintain records related to maintenance and assembly activities.
Ensure proper housekeeping and cleanliness of the work area.

Required Skills & Qualifications

ITI / Diploma in Fitter / Mechanical / Production Engineering or relevant technical qualification.
Minimum 2+ years of experience in mechanical assembly or fitting.
Good knowledge of assembly processes and mechanical fitting techniques.
Ability to read and understand 2D and assembly drawings.
Basic knowledge of GD&T.
Hands-on experience with hand tools and mechanical workshop equipment.
Knowledge of deburring, drilling, tapping, grinding, chamfering, filing, and buffing.
Basic knowledge of electrical wiring for fixtures.
Knowledge of QMS, 5S, and quality inspection procedures.
Good teamwork and communication skills.
Ability to work on large-scale projects and meet production timelines.

Preferred Experience

Experience with laser engraving machines.
Experience in industrial machinery, automation, SPM, or manufacturing environments.
Exposure to IMTES and quality management systems.
Experience in maintaining assembly and maintenance records.
Ability to identify and resolve basic mechanical assembly issues.

description:
A mobile technician diagnoses, troubleshoots, and repairs hardware and software issues on smartphones and tablets. They test devices, manage repair inventories, and provide customer support to ensure optimal device performance.
Key Responsibilities

- Diagnostics: Identify hardware failures (e.g., broken screens, bad batteries, faulty charging ports) and software errors (e.g., app crashes, OS glitches).
- Hardware Repair: Replace physical components such as screens, cameras, and batteries using specialized tools and micro-soldering techniques.
- Software Troubleshooting: Install OS updates, flash firmware, and resolve connectivity or system configuration problems.
- Customer Service: Explain repair processes, offer maintenance recommendations, and manage customer records.
- Inventory Management: Track and order replacement parts while maintaining a safe, organized workspace.

Qualifications & Skills

- High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification in electronics is a distinct advantage.
- Proficiency with mobile operating systems (iOS and Android) and electronic diagnostics.
- Robust manual dexterity, soldering skills, and attention to detail when handling delicate components.
- Excellent communication and time management skills.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
Who we are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About this Role

We are seeking a Mobile Service Assurance Engineer to join our Vodafone Network Operations Managed Services team in Bangalore or Pune. This role is focused on proactive and reactive support for Vodafone’s Mobile Service Assurance Team (MSAT), helping to identify, investigate, and resolve customer-impacting mobile network faults across mobile services. You will play a key role in monitoring service alarms, managing incidents end-to-end, supporting service restoration, and collaborating with technical teams and external partners to minimise customer impact. This opportunity is well suited to individuals with experience in telecommunications operations, service assurance, fault management, and mobile network technologies including GSM, LTE, and 5G.

What you’ll do

- Proactively monitor mobile service alarms, investigate service degradation, and initiate actions to reduce customer impact.
- Investigate, triage, and progress mobile network faults raised through Customer Operations and internal ticketing systems.
- Manage incidents throughout their lifecycle, including diagnosis, impact assessment, prioritisation, escalation, and resolution tracking.
- Maintain ownership of assigned incidents and ensure progression in line with agreed service levels and operational expectations.
- Collaborate with second-line support teams, engineering functions, and external vendors to resolve complex technical issues.
- Escalate incidents appropriately when resolution cannot be achieved within MSAT, ensuring clear accountability and follow-through.
- Provide accurate and timely updates in fault management platforms and operational reporting tools.
- Support rapid service recovery by identifying and driving required restoration activities.
- Identify recurring fault trends and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across operational processes.
- Maintain operational documentation and support knowledge sharing to improve consistency, efficiency, and service quality.
- Support fault management activities across both the existing Vodafone mobile network and the VodafoneThree integration landscape.
- Contribute to key performance objectives including SLA adherence, incident restoration times, alarm handling compliance, queue management, and high-quality fault diagnosis.

Position Summary

The Mobile Device Management (MDM) Engineer is responsible for monitoring, managing and supporting customer mobile device environments using the NinjaOne platform under the guidance of the MDM Team Lead. This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned incidents and service requests, maintaining ownership through resolution while ensuring compliance with contracted SLAs. The ideal candidate is customer focused, technically skilled and thrives in a fast paced operations environment. This position requires shift flexibility, including participation in rotating on call schedules and the ability to work varying shifts as business needs evolve. The MDM Engineer will regularly collaborate with customers, peers, vendors and leadership through phone, email, chat, video conferencing and ticketing systems such as ServiceNow to ensure timely and effective issue resolution.

Travel Requirements

This position does not require travel.

Key Responsibilities
• Monitor and manage enrolled mobile devices across iOS, Android and Windows platforms using the NinjaOne MDM platform.
• Troubleshoot mobile device enrollment, connectivity, policy compliance and application delivery issues using NinjaOne and remote support tools.
• Manage incidents, requests and changes through ServiceNow while documenting troubleshooting activities and customer communications.
• Take ownership of assigned tickets and drive issues through to resolution or appropriate escalation.
• Administer device configuration profiles, security policies and compliance baselines within NinjaOne to enforce organizational standards across managed endpoints.
• Manage application deployment, updates and removal across mobile device fleets using NinjaOne software management capabilities.
• Support device lifecycle activities including enrollment, onboarding, offboarding and remote wipe for lost or decommissioned devices.
• Communicate effectively with customers, peers, management and cross functional engineering teams regarding incidents, outages and change activities.
• Participate in an on call rotation to provide emergency support coverage when required.
• Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate with NinjaOne support or third party vendors as necessary.
• Contribute to the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, operational procedures and knowledge base articles.
• Recommend process improvements and identify operational risks or areas of concern to management.
• Continue developing technical expertise across additional MDM and endpoint management technologies as business needs evolve.
• Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work and/or military experience.
• 2+ years of experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC), Managed Services or IT Operations environment.
• 2+ years of hands on experience administering or supporting a Mobile Device Management platform in a production environment.
• Hands on experience with NinjaOne MDM including device enrollment, policy configuration, software deployment and compliance monitoring.
• Experience managing iOS, Android and Windows mobile devices including enrollment via Apple Business Manager, Android Enterprise or Windows Autopilot.

• Diagnose issues and provide timely solutions to minimize downtime. Process & Documentation:

description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a commercially minded, hands-on Senior Mobile Engineer with real connected-product / IoT experience to build and take long-term technical ownership of the mobile experience behind Pro Breeze connected products.

Based from our Bengaluru office, you will work with teams across the UK, India, China and other markets, helping us build a high-quality software experience around a growing range of connected consumer products.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. We are looking for someone who has personally shipped production mobile applications that connect to real physical products. Please do not apply if your experience is primarily standard mobile apps, websites or dashboards without device connectivity.

This is not a narrow development role where requirements are fully specified and handed over as tickets. We need someone who can take a broad product objective, understand the underlying problem, shape a practical solution, build it, test it properly and support it in production.

You will help us build, improve and scale the mobile experience across a growing range of connected products, working closely with product development, design, customer experience and our teams in China.

You should be highly comfortable using modern AI-assisted and agentic development tools to work significantly faster, while still taking full responsibility for security, reliability, maintainability and the quality of what is released.

Key Responsibilities

Build and Own the Mobile Experience
•
Build, maintain and continuously improve our connected-product mobile app across iOS and Android.

•
Turn product ideas and rough briefs into clear, reliable customer-facing software.

•
Build consistent and intuitive experiences across different connected appliances.

•
Own functionality including accounts, device onboarding, pairing, product control, notifications, support journeys and analytics.

•
Take responsibility for App Store and Google Play releases and ongoing compatibility.

Connected Products & IoT
•
Integrate mobile applications with real connected consumer products using technologies such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE and third-party IoT platforms.

•
Build reliable onboarding, pairing and device-control experiences.

•
Diagnose real-world connectivity and device-control problems across different phones, networks, products and environments.

•
Work with product development and our China teams when issues cross between the mobile app, connected-device platform, firmware and physical product.

•
Help evaluate technical approaches that improve reliability, customer experience and development speed.

•
Test extensively against real devices rather than relying only on emulators or ideal conditions.

AI-Native Engineering
•
Use modern coding agents and AI-assisted development tools as part of your normal engineering workflow.

•
Use AI to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation without lowering engineering standards.

•
Know when generated code is wrong, unsafe or unnecessarily complex and be able to correct it.

•
Continuously improve how agentic development can allow a small engineering team to deliver at high speed.

Production Ownership & Quality
•
Own features from initial problem through implementation, testing, release and production support.

•
Investigate root causes rather than repeatedly patching symptoms.

•
Build reliable error handling, logging, monitoring and analytics in

description:
Job highlights

• 3-5 years experience with CNC Turn-Mill programming and operation, ITI/Diploma in Mechanical, skilled in Siemens, Fanuc, or Haas controls

• Set up, program, and operate CNC Turn-Mill/Axis machines; interpret blueprints; perform maintenance and finishing; troubleshoot mechanical issues; ensure quality and precision

Job Opportunity: CNC Turn-Mill / CNC 5 Axis Programmer & Operator (Contractual) role on 3rd party payroll.
Role: CNC Turn-Mill Operator/Axis / Programmer
Employment Type: Contractual- 3rd Party payroll.

Location: Bangalore, Electronic City

Company: Tata Advanced Systems Limited (TASL)

Experience: 3 to 5 Years

Education: ITI/Diploma-Mechanical

Position Overview:

We are looking for a skilled and independent CNC Turn-Mill/Axis Programmer & Operator for a contractual role. The ideal candidate will be responsible for setting up, programming, and operating advanced CNC Turn-Mill machines while ensuring parts are produced safely, efficiently, and strictly to technical specifications.
Key Responsibilities:

• Machine Operation: Set up and operate CNC Turn-Mill /Axis machines independently during assigned shifts.

• Programming & Controls: Write, modify, and interpret G-code and M-code programs directly on machine controls (Siemens, Fanuc, or Haas).

• Blueprint Reading: Interpret complex technical drawings, including engineering dimensions, geometric tolerances, and parts specifications.

• Operational Maintenance: Monitor machine operations smoothly, change collets, tool inserts, blocks, and tool holders, and maintain proper coolant levels.

• Finishing Work: Perform necessary secondary manual operations such as deburring, sanding, and grinding.

• Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve minor mechanical issues on the spot to minimize machine downtime.

• Quality & Adjustments: Make real-time machining adjustments to verify the finished parts match exact specifications and tight tolerances.

Required Skills & Competencies:

• Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of CNC Turn-Mill axes, tool setups, and component geometry.

• Mathematics: Robust foundation in industrial math and geometry for calculating dimensions, angles, and offsets.

• Time Management: Ability to self-manage time effectively to fulfill production targets and meet strict project deadlines.

• Adaptability: High level of involvement with a strong willingness to learn new machining technologies and techniques.

description:
We are seeking a skilled CNC Turning Operator to operate, monitor, and maintain CNC Turning (Lathe) machines for the production of precision components. The candidate should be able to interpret engineering drawings, perform machine setups, monitor quality standards, and ensure production targets are achieved.

Key Responsibilities
• Operate CNC Turning/Lathe machines to manufacture components as per specifications.

• Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and technical documents.

• Load raw materials and set machine parameters as per job requirements.

• Perform tool setting, offset adjustments, and tool changes.

• Inspect finished parts using measuring instruments such as Vernier Calipers, Micrometers, Bore Gauges, and Height Gauges.

• Monitor machine performance and ensure product quality standards are maintained.

• Identify and troubleshoot minor machine issues.

• Perform routine maintenance and cleaning of machines.

• Follow production schedules and achieve daily output targets.

• Maintain production and inspection records.

Required Skills
• Knowledge of CNC Turning/Lathe machine operations.

• Ability to read engineering drawings and GD&T.

• Understanding of cutting tools, inserts, feeds, and speeds.

• Familiarity with precision measuring instruments.

• Basic knowledge of CNC controls such as Fanuc, Siemens, or Mitsubishi.

• Strong attention to detail and quality standards.

Qualifications
• Diploma / ITI in Mechanical Engineering, Fitter, Turner, Machinist, or related field.

• Certification in CNC Machine Operation is an added advantage.

• It is a Full Time Manufacturing job for candidates with 2 - 6+ years Experience.

We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward. Designation: HVAC Specialist Qualification: Diploma in Mechanical / Environmental Engineering / Science / Chemical Experience: 3+ years in HVAC operations or monitoring (chiller plants, AHUs, cooling towers) in commercial, IT or critical facilities, with BMS/IBMS exposure. Key responsibilities Monitor HVAC in real time through BMS/IBMS, IoT and CoE dashboards: chillers, AHU/FAHU, CHW supply/return temperatures and ΔT, condenser water, temperature and humidity, VFDs, pumps and energy. Track HVAC KPIs: kW/TR, plant efficiency, energy, temperature and humidity compliance, equipment availability, downtime, alarm closure time, critical alerts and BMS communication health. Download and validate monthly BMS performance data for chillers, cooling towers, pumps, chiller plant, AHUs, HRWs, exhausts and PHEs. Classify alarms as Critical, Major or Minor, log and triage them, and escalate to L2 per the matrix. Flag abnormal trends (low ΔT, hunting, short cycling, sensor drift) to L2. Produce weekly health, alarm, incident and monitoring reports, and maintain logs. Follow SOPs and validate data for missing or abnormal points. Company Description

In India, Bosch is a leading supplier of technology and services in the areas of Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. Additionally, Bosch has in India the largest development center outside Germany, for end to end engineering and technology solutions. The Bosch Group operates in India through twelve companies with a combined strength of over 31,500 associates which includes around 15,650 research and development associates.

Bosch Automotive Electronics India Pvt. Ltd. (RBAI) is a 100% subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH . Established in 2009, in Naganathapura - Bengaluru, RBAI is primarily focused in manufacturing electronic products for the automotive sector. RBAI has consistently added an average of one product every year resulting in a wide range of products comprising – Engine Control Units (ECU) for both 4W and 2W, Body Control Modules (BCM), ECUs for ABS, DC-DC Converters, iTraMS (Intelligent communication control unit) to name a few. RBAI also produces products for eMobility like MCU (Motor control Unit), C-Box (Communication Box), VCUs (Vehicle Control Unit), Central gateway modules and is geared up for other futuristic products. RBAI with its diverse portfolio, not only caters to local markets, but also exports products to all major global customers. The Naganathapura Plant (NhP1) is seen as a benchmark in Operational Excellence in AE and Bosch India , using an integrated approach of Bosch Production System (BPS) and I4.0. With a young and agile team, RBAI’s mission statement ‘Be RBAI’ (Be Reliable Benchmark Agile Innovative) is a testament to our commitment in providing best in class products and services for its customers.

description:
Summary:

This is a full-time role in TNT, located in Attibele, Bangalore for a “ Nesting Engineer”. The duties for this role include but are not limited to, working closely with the Team Lead to develop shop drawings, fabrication / erection drawings with CAD and Tekla software and especially “nesting for steel structures and pre-engineered buildings”.

Role:
• Proficiency in AutoCAD, Tekla, ProNest, Most2D or other industry-related nesting software.
• Ability to read and understand architectural and structural drawings.
• Experience in generating fabrication drawings, shop and erection drawings for steel structures and pre-engineered buildings.
• Experience with plasma cutting and other related software.
• Hands-on experience in generating CNC files for the plasma machines using Most2D, ProNest or any other nesting software.
• Work with shop personnel to resolve issues arising in the manufacturing process, including reviewing punch lists for completeness against the contract documents, BOMS and cut sheets, fabricating fit-in-place assemblies, pieces or assemblies that require cutting, grinding, welding and final finishing in order to match approved shop drawings.
• Knowledge about raw material sizes and industry standards.
• Ability to achieve minimum scrap percentage with efficient nesting process.

Qualification & Abilities:
• Degree or Diploma in Civil/Mechanical Engineering or equivalent work experience.
• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
• Self-directed and self-motivated with a demonstrated ability to meet or exceed objectives.
• Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and work within a team environment.
• Minimum 1-2 yrs of experience in same field of nesting or freshers can also apply with auto cad knowledge.

Job description:

We are looking for a skilled UPS Service Engineer to install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the reliable operation of UPS equipment, performing preventive maintenance, attending customer service calls, and providing effective technical support at customer locations.

Key Responsibilities
• Install, commission, and configure UPS systems at customer locations.
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of UPS equipment.
• Diagnose and troubleshoot UPS faults, power supply issues, and battery-related problems.
• Inspect, test, and replace UPS batteries, rectifiers, inverters, and other components as required.
• Conduct battery health checks, voltage measurements, and load testing.
• Attend breakdown calls and provide timely on-site technical support.
• Maintain service reports, maintenance checklists, and customer service records.
• Coordinate with customers and internal technical teams to resolve service issues.
• Ensure compliance with electrical safety procedures during installation and maintenance.
• Provide technical guidance to customers on UPS operation and maintenance.
• Travel to customer sites as required for installation, inspection, and service activities.

Required Skills and Qualifications
• Diploma or ITI in Electrical, Electronics, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
• Experience in UPS installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
• Hands-on experience with online UPS systems, offline UPS systems, and battery banks.
• Knowledge of electrical circuits, power electronics, rectifiers, inverters, and battery charging systems.
• Ability to use multimeters, clamp meters, and other electrical testing instruments.
• Good troubleshooting, problem-solving, and customer-handling skills.
• Willingness to travel to customer locations for field service activities.
• Good communication skills and the ability to prepare service reports.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in LED/LCD/TV/display servicing, desktop/laptop hardware, AV equipment, electrical/electronic installation, or similar technical field-service work. • Good troubleshooting and problem-solving ability.
• Good communication and customer-handling skills.
• Willingness to travel extensively for installation and service calls.
• Ability to work independently at customer locations.

Preferred Experience

• Interactive Flat Panel Display (IFPD) installation/service
• Smart TV / LED / LCD TV servici

Location: Arekere - Bengaluru Working Hours: 9:30 to 6:30 (General Shift) 6 Days Working Sunday Fixed Off Program Details We are hiring fresh Engineering Graduates, Diploma Holders, and ITI Graduates for our Laptop Repair & Refurbishment team.

Keep properties running. Close issues fast. Protect the living experience.

Designation: MEP

Location: Bangalore

Salary Range: up to 4 LPA (Subject to hike according to market standards)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Required: 2 - 5 years in real estate

Why this role exists

In coliving, resident experience is not defined only at the time of move-in. It is defined every single day through how reliably the property functions.

Residents live in the property full-time.

This means:

• Electricity cannot fail frequently

• Water issues cannot remain unresolved

• Plumbing breakdowns cannot wait for days

• Common areas cannot remain dysfunctional

At scale, coliving operations face continuous pressure because:

• Properties operate at high occupancy density

• Asset usage is constant

• Wear and tear increases rapidly

• Repair tickets are ongoing, not occasional

In this environment, even small maintenance delays immediately affect:

• Resident satisfaction

• Complaint volume

• Property experience

• Operational efficiency

Most operational failures today happen because:

• Tickets remain open beyond timelines

• Temporary fixes are used instead of permanent resolution

• Teams depend excessively on external vendors

• Preventive maintenance is inconsistent

• Material tracking is weak, leading to delays and wastage

• Repeat issues occur due to poor technical diagnosis

This role exists to ensure:

• All maintenance issues are resolved within defined timelines

• Critical systems remain functional consistently

• Preventive maintenance reduces breakdowns proactively

• Maximum issues are solved in-house through technical ownership

• Material usage and inventory are tracked with discipline

If this role is strong:

• Properties remain reliable and functional

• Complaints reduce significantly

• Downtime remains low

• Operations become faster and more efficient

If this role is weak:

• Breakdowns repeat frequently

• Escalations increase

• Vendor dependency risesli>

• Resident experience deteriorates

This role directly controls:

Property uptime + issue resolution speed + operational reliability

Your mandate is clear

• Close all tickets within defined TAT with complete resolution

• Maintain uptime of all critical systems

• Execute preventive maintenance consistently

• Reduce vendor dependency through strong technical ownership

• Maintain discipline in material usage and tracking

This is not a technician role. This is a property uptime ownership role.

Coliving operations are built on:

The experience works only when:

Job Summary:

The skilled technician should have hands-on experience in the installation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of BMS, CCTV, Fire Alarm, and Access Control Systems. The candidate should have practical knowledge of field installation activities, cable termination, equipment testing, troubleshooting, and site execution.

Key Responsibilities:
• Carry out installation, testing, and commissioning of BMS, CCTV, Fire Alarm, and Access Control Systems.
• Perform cable laying, cable dressing, routing, termination, and identification as per project requirements.
• Install and configure field devices, including sensors, detectors, controllers, cameras, access readers, and other system components.
• Assist in installation and testing of BMS panels, DDC controllers, and associated field devices.
• Perform installation and testing of CCTV cameras, DVR/NVR systems, and associated equipment.
• Install and test Fire Alarm Control Panels (FACP), smoke detectors, heat detectors, MCPs, hooters, and other fire alarm devices.
• Carry out installation and testing of Access Control Panels, card readers, electromagnetic locks, and related equipment.
• Conduct basic troubleshooting and rectify installation-related faults.
• Ensure all installation and testing activities are completed as per approved drawings, project specifications, and quality standards.
• Coordinate with site engineers, supervisors, and project teams to complete assigned work within project timelines.
• Maintain proper records of installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
• Follow site safety procedures and ensure compliance with EHS requirements.

Specific skills required:
• Candidates with practical site experience in any of the above systems are encouraged to apply.
• Knowledge of electrical wiring, cable termination, and panel installation.
• Ability to read and understand electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and installation layouts.
• Knowledge of basic troubleshooting and testing procedures.

• Willingness to travel to project sites as required.

CCTV Installation & Maintenance Technician – Smart Parking Infrastructure

BengaluruExperience: 2–5 years preferredQualification: ITI / Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, Electronics & Communication, Networking or a related fieldSalary: ₹20,000–₹30,000 per month, depending on experience and technical skills Job Summary We are looking for a hands-on CCTV Installation & Maintenance Technician to install, commission, troubleshoot and maintain CCTV cameras and related equipment for smart parking infrastructure projects across Bengaluru. The candidate will work with IP cameras, network cables, PoE switches, power supplies and other field equipment. The role requires practical technical knowledge, willingness to travel to project sites and the ability to resolve equipment issues independently.

Key Responsibilities
1. CCTV Installation ● Install and mount CCTV cameras on poles, walls and other designated locations. ● Handle camera mounting brackets, junction boxes, enclosures and related accessories. ● Install and route CAT6/network cables and electrical cables as required. ● Terminate RJ45 connectors and test network cables. ● Ensure correct camera positioning, angle, height and field of view. ● Assist with installation of network switches, PoE switches, power supplies and roadside equipment cabinets. ● Coordinate with civil and electrical teams during pole installation and equipment commissioning. 2. Networking & Camera Configuration ● Install and configure IP CCTV cameras. ● Configure camera IP addresses and basic network settings. ● Connect cameras to PoE switches and verify network connectivity. ● Troubleshoot cameras that are offline or not communicating with the central system. ● Perform basic network tests using ping, cable testers and other diagnostic tools. ● Assist with camera integration into the video management system (VMS) or smart parking platform. ● Understand basic TCP/IP, LAN, IP addressing and PoE networking. 3. Field Operations & Reporting ● Travel to different smart parking project locations across Bengaluru. ● Conduct site inspections and verify installation readiness. ● Maintain daily installation and maintenance reports. ● Record camera serial numbers, IP addresses, locations and equipment details. ● Take site photographs before and after installation. ● Coordinate with the technical team and report unresolved issues. ● Follow safety procedures while working on roadside installations and elevated equipment. description:
Company Description Present IT Solutions, established in 2015, provides comprehensive IT solutions and services to a broad range of clients. The company specializes in laptop servicing, servers, and storage solutions, ensuring reliable support for critical systems. Present IT Solutions also supplies IT products including laptops, desktops, printers, servers, storage devices, software, PC accessories, and laptop spares. Based in Bengaluru, the company offers on-site services across the city, focusing on responsive support and practical, customer-centered solutions.

Role Description The Surveillance Technician is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru. This role is responsible for installing, configuring, and maintaining surveillance systems, including cameras, recording devices, and related security hardware. The technician will monitor system performance, conduct regular inspections, identify and troubleshoot technical issues, and coordinate repairs or upgrades as needed. Daily tasks include documenting system configurations, maintaining logs of incidents and maintenance activities, and supporting physical security measures in customer locations. The role also involves collaborating with supervisors, clients, and other team members to ensure surveillance solutions meet operational and safety requirements.

Qualifications
• Candidates should possess strong Surveillance and Physical Security skills, including familiarity with CCTV systems and access control.
• Candidates should possess solid Troubleshooting skills for hardware, software, and network-related issues in security and surveillance setups.
• Candidates should possess Security-related knowledge, including basic security protocols and best practices for protecting assets and information.
• Candidates should possess Supervisory Skills to coordinate tasks on-site, support junior team members, and communicate effectively with clients.
• Candidates should possess basic IT and networking skills relevant to IP cameras, NVR/DVR systems, cabling, and configuration.
• Candidates should possess good communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in the field.
• Relevant technical certification or diploma in electronics, IT, or a related field is preferred; prior experience in surveillance or security systems is an advantage.

description:
CCTV & Access Control Technician

Job Summary : Key Responsibilities :

- Install and configure CCTV cameras, NVRs, DVRs, and video management systems.
- Install and maintain access control systems, biometric devices, card readers, and door controllers.
- Perform network configuration for IP-based security devices.
- Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
- Conduct preventive maintenance and system health checks.
- Run and terminate network cables, CAT6/CAT6A cabling, and fiber optic connections when required.
- Prepare installation reports, documentation, and service records.
- Coordinate with clients and vendors for project implementation and support.
- Ensure compliance with safety and security standards.

Required Skills :

- Knowledge of CCTV systems, IP cameras, NVR/DVR configuration.
- Experience with access control systems, biometrics, and attendance systems.
- Understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLAN, PoE, switches, routers).
- Knowledge of structured cabling and rack installation.
- Ability to read technical drawings and wiring diagrams.
- Valuable troubleshooting and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications :

- Diploma/ITI/B.E. in Electronics, Electrical, Networking, or related field.
- 1-5 years of experience in CCTV and access control installation and support.
- Experience with security brands such as HID Global, Verkada, Honeywell, Hikvision, and Dahua Technology is an advantage.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
Solar O&M Technician - Bangalore (Bengaluru)

Company: Leading
Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience Required: 2 - 3 years
Salary: 4,20,000 per year

Job Title: Solar O&M; Technician

Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

Industry: Solar Energy

Job Summary

We are hiring an experienced Solar O&M; Technician with 23 years of hands-on experience in the Operation & Maintenance of rooftop and ground-mounted Solar PV power plants. The candidate should have solid electrical troubleshooting skills, knowledge of solar equipment, and a valid Wireman / Supervisor Licence.

The role involves preventive and corrective maintenance, plant monitoring, troubleshooting, safety compliance, and travel to project sites as required.

Key Responsibilities

Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance of rooftop and ground-mounted Solar PV systems.
Inspect PV modules, string inverters, ACDBs, DCDBs, transformers, HT/LT panels, cables, earthing systems, and electrical equipment.
Monitor plant performance through SCADA and remote monitoring systems.
Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical faults to ensure maximum plant availability.
Supervise module cleaning and scheduled maintenance activities.
Record daily generation data, breakdown reports, maintenance activities, and site observations.
Coordinate with the Asset Manager for preventive maintenance, breakdowns, shutdowns, and reporting.
Follow EHS, electrical safety, PTW (Permit-to-Work), and LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) procedures.
Maintain tools, testing instruments, spare parts, and site maintenance records.
Support commissioning, testing, performance evaluation, and site audits.
Maintain proper housekeeping and safety standards at project sites.

Salary: Up to 35,000 CTC per month

Requirements

ITI / Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent.
Valid Wireman / Supervisor Licence is mandatory.
23 years of hands-on experience in Solar PV O&M;.
Experience with rooftop and/or ground-mounted solar power plants.
Good knowledge of Solar PV systems, string inverters, ACDB, DCDB, transformers, HT/LT panels, cables, and earthing systems.
Ability to read and interpret SLDs, electrical schematics, and technical drawings.
Basic computer knowledge for maintenance reporting and documentation.
Knowledge of PTW, LOTO, EHS, and electrical safety procedures.
Willingness to work at heights and in outdoor environments.
Willingness to travel to project sites and company offices as required.

Benefits .

description:
SUMMARY
Job Description Site Engineer (Solar C&I Projects)
Position: Site Engineer Solar EPC (Rooftop & Ground-Mounted C&I Projects)
Location: Bangaore
Frequent travel/long site postings expected.
Reporting To: Project Manager

Role Objective
To supervise and execute on-site installation of solar EPC projects, ensuring quality,
safety, and timely progress as per design and project plan.
Key Responsibilities
1. Site Supervision & Execution
Oversee daily installation activities (module mounting, structure erection,
cabling, inverter & LT/HT panels, earthing, etc.).
Coordinate with subcontractors, technicians, and labour teams for smooth
execution.
Verify work against drawings and BOQ.
2. Quality & Safety
Ensure compliance with safety protocols, PPE usage, and safe installation
practices.
Conduct on-site quality checks and inspection of materials and workmanship.
Maintain site checklists, quality reports, and handover documentation.
3. Material & Resource Management
Track and manage receipt of materials at site; maintain stock records.
Raise material indents/requirements to PM on time.
Minimize wastage and optimize resource utilization.
4. Coordination & Reporting
Act as the first point of contact for day-to-day site issues.
Provide daily/weekly progress updates to the Project Manager.
Assist in site measurements, billing verification, and client inspections.
5. Testing & Commissioning Support
Support pre-commissioning tests (continuity, insulation resistance, string
testing, etc.).
Assist in synchronisation with grid/discom approvals.
Ensure smooth site handover to O&M team.
Desired Profile
Education: Diploma / B.E. in Electrical / Mechanical / Civil.
Experience:
o 2 5 years for Diploma holders, 1 3 years for Engineers.
o Hands-on exposure to solar project installation (rooftop or ground -
mount).
Skills:
o Good knowledge of solar electrical systems (DC, AC, LT/HT interface).
o Ability to read drawings (civil, structural, electrical).
o Vendor/subcontractor coordination.
o Strong problem-solving and site communication.
Performance Metrics (KPIs)
Adherence to site schedule (actual vs. planned progress).
Safety compliance (zero accidents).
Quality compliance (snag-free execution).
Material reconciliation accuracy.
Client/PM satisfaction with site execution.
Diploma Engineers: Commensurate with Industry Standards

description:
CCTV & Network Engineer (ELV / Field Service)
D'VIBE PVT LTD • Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
About the job
We are looking for a CCTV and Networking Engineer to take ownership of surveillance and ELV installations from site survey through commissioning and long-term support. You will handle IP network integration, run preventive and corrective maintenance, and coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams to keep systems reliable and SLAs met.

Key Responsibilities
• Installation & Commissioning
• Conduct site surveys and recommend camera placement, cabling routes, and network design.
• Install, configure, and commission IP/analog cameras, NVRs/DVRs, VMS, and PoE switches.
• Supervise cabling (CAT6/fibre), termination, labelling, and testing.
• Complete installations to drawings and BOQ, and prepare as-built documentation.
• Network Integration & Configuration
• Configure IP addressing, VLANs, routing, and basic switching for surveillance networks.
• Integrate CCTV with access control, fire alarm, intercom, and other ELV systems as required.
• Set up remote viewing, port forwarding/VPN, and mobile/VMS client access.
• Troubleshoot bandwidth, latency, packet loss, and PoE issues.
• Maintenance & Support
• Perform scheduled preventive maintenance (PM) visits and health checks.
• Diagnose and resolve faults on cameras, recorders, storage, switches, and cabling.
• Handle service tickets within SLA and maintain accurate service reports.
• Manage firmware updates, backups, and storage/retention checks.
• Site Ownership & Coordination
• Act as the single point of contact for assigned sites.
• Coordinate with clients, IT teams, civil/electrical contractors, and OEM/vendor support.
• Manage material requirements, site stock, and RMA/warranty claims.
• Brief and guide junior technicians and helpers on site.
• Documentation & Reporting
• Maintain IP schedules, network diagrams, asset registers, and handover documents.
• Submit daily/weekly progress and service reports.
• Obtain client sign-offs for commissioning and closure.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, IT, or a related field (ITI with strong experience may be considered).
Technical skills:
• Hands-on experience with IP CCTV brands (Hikvision, Dahua, CP Plus, Axis, Hanwha, etc.).
• Solid understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, DHCP, NAT, and PoE.
• Experience with managed switches (Cisco, D-Link, TP-Link, Netgear, or similar).
• Knowledge of structured cabling (CAT6, fibre splicing/OTDR basics) and testing tools.
• Familiarity with VMS platforms, NVR/storage sizing, and video analytics basics.

Position Summary

The Accountant will hold a critical role within the finance team, focusing on the integrity of financial data and adherence to regulatory standards. This position is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, preparing detailed financial reports, and ensuring compliance with accounting principles.

- Maintain comprehensive financial records while ensuring alignment with established accounting standards.
- Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for management analysis.
- Assist in formulating budgets and generating forecasts to support strategic planning.
- Reconcile bank statements accurately, ensuring all transactions are properly recorded.
- Collaborate with various departments to deliver insightful financial analyses.
- Ensure adherence to tax regulations, providing support during the tax preparation process.
- Facilitate audits by offering necessary documentation and clarifications as required.

- A minimum of 2 to 4 years of experience in accounting or related financial roles.
- Proficient in accounting software applications and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
- Strong understanding of accounting principles and practices is essential.

Key Competencies

- Exceptional analytical capabilities coupled with effective problem-solving skills.
- Attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy in financial reporting.
- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, allowing for clear collaboration across departments.

Company: GooCampus Edu Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Location: Bangalore
Job Type: Full-Time | Permanent
Experience: 0–3 Years
Qualification: Bachelor's Degree / MBA
Salary: ₹25,000 – ₹40,000 per month + Incentives & Commissions

About GooCampus

GooCampus is a medical education and career consulting company with over a decade of experience helping doctors and students explore medical education and international career pathways, including the UK, Australia, USA and other destinations.

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated Sales Associate to join our Bangalore team. The role involves sales, business development, client engagement and initial counselling for doctors, medical students and parents exploring international medical education and career opportunities.

Key Responsibilities
• Handle and qualify leads generated through GooCampus's marketing, website, events, referrals and other channels.
• Speak with doctors, students and parents to understand their career goals and requirements.
• Explain GooCampus services and provide initial information about relevant pathways.
• Coordinate detailed counselling sessions with senior counsellors and mentors.
• Follow up with prospects and work towards successful conversions.
• Build and maintain relationships with doctors, students, consultants and institutions.
• Identify and develop new business and partnership opportunities.
• Support seminars, webinars, meetings and other business-development activities.
• Maintain accurate lead information, follow-ups and sales activity in the CRM.
• Use AI tools, CRM platforms and digital tools to improve productivity and sales effectiveness.

Requirements
• Bachelor's Degree or MBA.
• 0–3 years of experience in sales, business development, education consulting, healthcare or a related field.
• Excellent communication skills, particularly in English.
• Hindi and regional-language skills will be an advantage.
• Strong interpersonal, sales and negotiation skills.
• Good follow-up and relationship-management skills.
• Comfortable working with targets.
• Good computer and CRM skills.
• Willingness to learn and use AI tools such as ChatGPT and other digital platforms.

What We Offer
• ₹25,000–₹40,000/month
• Performance incentives and sales commissions.
• 3-month probation period followed by confirmation based on performance.
• Opportunity to work in the international medical education and career consulting industry.
• Career growth in Sales, Business Development and Consulting.

• Health insurance
• Paid sick time
• Provident Fund

description:
Lab Assistant – Design & Technology

Location: Inventure Academy, Bangalore

Experience: 2–5 years in STEAM/makerspace lab operations, or hands-on education (school or creative environments preferred)

Why This Role is Exciting

True learning is tactile, curious, and a little bit noisy. As Lab Assistant – Design & Technology, you will help students in (V–VI or VII–VIII) and/or specific zones/technologies (e.g., Red Zone operations) and mentor higher grades on independent projects, turn ideas into working prototypes—safely, creatively, and with pride. From paper mechanisms and stop-motion to woodwork, mechanics, and basic electronics, you will guide learners through a progressive design-engineering journey while keeping the space humming, safe, and inspiring.

What You’ll Do
• Facilitate D&T and Makerspace sessions for assigned grades (V–VI or VII–VIII) and/or specific zones/technologies (e.g., Red Zone operations).
• Guide students through a scaffolded curriculum—from paper builds and stop-motion to wood, mechanics, and electricity—emphasising design thinking and iteration.
• Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols across green/yellow/red hazard classifications; conduct tool-use demos and safety briefings.
• Maintain tools, equipment, and materials: routine checks, calibration, consumables tracking, and timely repair/escalation.
• Prepare the lab before sessions and reset after: layouts, safety signage, tool stations, and clean-down to keep the space classroom-ready.

What You Bring
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering/design/education or equivalent practical experience in makerspaces/DIY labs.
• Hands-on competence with common makerspace tools and workflows (hand tools, basic power tools, electronics basics; familiarity with microcontrollers/3D printing/laser cutting is a plus).
• Strong safety mindset with experience managing hazard zones and enforcing SOPs; first-aid/safety certifications are an advantage.
• Ability to engage young learners: clear instructions, patient coaching, and upbeat classroom management.
• Organised, proactive, and detail-oriented—able to juggle prep, facilitation, and maintenance smoothly.
• Effective communicator and collaborator with teachers, students, and operations teams.
• A maker’s curiosity: you like to tinker, document, and improve systems over time.

Apply if you are…
• A high-energy maker who balances creativity with meticulous safety and planning.
• A patient coach who can break complex builds into simple, achievable steps.
• A systems-thinker who keeps tools sharp, logs tidy, and the lab running like clockwork.
• An advocate for holistic education who believes design, engineering, and craft belong in every learner’s journey.

Job Description:

We are looking for enthusiastic and technically skilled Lab Technicians to join our Digital Lab team. The candidate will be responsible for wiring harness assembly, electrical panel integration, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation.

Key Responsibilities:
Assemble and prepare wiring harnesses as per engineering drawings and wiring diagrams.

Perform wire cutting, stripping, crimping, soldering, and cable termination.

Assemble and integrate electrical and control panels.

Perform cable routing, dressing, and panel wiring.

Read and interpret electrical wiring and interconnection diagrams.

Conduct continuity, insulation resistance, and functional testing.

Work with Digital Multimeters, Oscilloscopes, Function Generators, and Power Supplies.

Support troubleshooting, panel modifications, and electrical testing.

Assist in preparing and updating wiring diagrams using AutoCAD or equivalent tools.

Follow EHS, PPE, 5S, and quality standards.

Required Skills:
Wiring Harness Assembly
Electrical Panel Wiring & Integration
Crimping, Soldering & Termination
Electrical Testing & Troubleshooting
Reading Electrical Drawings
Basic AutoCAD Knowledge
Knowledge of EHS and 5S practices

description:
Company Name: Manipal Hospitals

Job Title: Lab Technician - Nagar Road

Job Description:

We are seeking a motivated and skilled Lab Technician to join our team at Manipal Hospitals, Nagar Road. The ideal candidate will be responsible for performing various laboratory tests and procedures that assist in the diagnosis and treatment of patients. You will work closely with other healthcare professionals to ensure accurate and efficient laboratory services.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct routine laboratory tests and analyses on patient specimens.

• Prepare and maintain laboratory equipment and instruments, ensuring they are in proper working condition.

• Record and report test results accurately and promptly, following established protocols.

• Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards in the laboratory environment.

• Maintain accurate laboratory records and documentation.

• Assist in inventory management of laboratory supplies and reagents.

• Participate in continuous education and training programs to stay updated with advancements in laboratory technology.

• Provide support to healthcare staff and assist with patient interactions when required.

Skills and Qualifications:

• Bachelor?s degree or diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology or a related field.

• Proven experience working as a Lab Technician in a clinical or hospital setting.

• Strong knowledge of laboratory procedures, equipment, and safety protocols.

• Ability to work well under pressure and manage multiple tasks.

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Proficiency in using laboratory information systems and electronic medical records.

• Familiarity with quality control and assurance processes.

• Certification from a recognized medical technology board would be an advantage.

Tools and Equipment Required:

• Laboratory analyzers and equipment (e.g., centrifuges, microscopes, spectrophotometers).

• PCs and laboratory information management systems (LIMS).

• Personal protective equipment (PPE) including gloves, masks, and lab coats.

• Basic laboratory supplies such as reagents, slides, and petri dishes.

• Access to reference materials and databases for medical laboratory practices.

Join our dedicated team at Manipal Hospitals, where your expertise as a Lab Technician will contribute to delivering exceptional patient care and advancing healthcare outcomes.

description:
Position: Teacher - Universal High School

Reporting Manager: Head of Department / Co-ordinator

Primary Purpose: The core purpose of the Teacher's role at Universal is to enable students to learn effectively and to provide support for the academic and pastoral needs of the students. The teacher should always support the aims and values of the school.

Why Build Your Career with Universal Education

In a world where change is constant, stability and growth rarely come together. At Universal Education, they do.

Here’s what makes Universal an exciting and trusted place to build your career 👇

Performance = Stability

If you perform well and deliver consistently, your stability with Universal is assured. We don’t talk about this often — but in today’s uncertain times, that assurance truly matters.

Career Path Visibility

We ensure clear growth trajectories and structured feedback so every employee knows what’s next in their journey — no ambiguity, just clarity and opportunity.

Continuous Development

Learning never stops at Universal. From professional upskilling to leadership development and digital learning pathways, we invest deeply in every individual’s growth.

Tuition Fee Benefits

As part of the Universal family, you can enrol your children in our schools with tuition fee waivers — a meaningful advantage for those who value education.

At Universal, we offer the best of both worlds — the energy of a growing organisation and the stability of an institution built on 3 decades of trust.

Our Interview Process & Application For The Role

Our process is comprehensive to ensure we maintain quality throughout practices ensuring continuous improvements of Student Outcomes & Teacher Delivery Effectiveness.

Step 1: Application Submission (Please map the fields Section, Academics, Primary & Secondary Location correctly, rest of the things which are not applicable, please select NA or Not Applicable)

Generally, we screen profiles within 48 - 72 hours of submission. Due to high volumes, sometimes this can be slightly delayed.

Introductory Call with a HR member for Fitment covering your Experience & Impact

Step 2: Online Assessment to determine the Subject Proficiency and Online Demo. Right fit candidates would generally receive a virtual assessment to be completed within 48-72 hours of Step 1.

Step 3: In-Person round at School with Principal / Co-ordinator & Demo

Step 4: Technical Rounds with Senior member (HOS, Central Academic Team), if required

Step 5: Final Call with Senior HR member for closure & next steps.

If you’re someone who thrives in a high-performance, positive, and purpose-driven environment, Universal Education is where you’ll grow, contribute, and belong.

Join us. Build your legacy with Universal.

description:
Company Description Raphaz Health Care is a home health organization committed to delivering patient-centered medical and nursing services in the community. Based in Bengaluru, the team focuses on providing safe, high-quality care in the comfort of patients’ homes, supporting recovery, independence, and long-term well-being. The organization values collaboration, clinical excellence, and clear communication among healthcare professionals, patients, and families. Raphaz Health Care encourages continuous learning, ethical practice, and respect for diverse backgrounds.
Role Description The Home Health Nurse is a full-time role responsible for providing direct nursing care to patients in their homes and coordinating with physicians and other healthcare professionals. This hybrid position is based in Bengaluru, with primary duties in the field and some work-from-home flexibility for care planning, documentation, and telehealth follow-ups. Daily responsibilities include assessing patient conditions, administering medications and treatments, managing wound care, monitoring vital signs, and educating patients and caregivers on care plans and preventive health. The nurse will develop and update individualized care plans, maintain accurate clinical documentation, and communicate changes in patient status to the healthcare team. The role also involves promoting safety in the home environment, supporting patient and family questions, and participating in quality improvement activities.
Qualifications

• Strong clinical foundation in Nursing and Medicine, with the ability to apply evidence-based practices in a home care setting.

Job Overview We are seeking a passionate and dedicated Primary Social Studies Teacher (PRT) to join our educational team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, delivering, and managing engaging and effective social studies lessons for pre-primary students. This role is crucial in fostering a foundational understanding of civic responsibility, history, geography, and social awareness in young learners. We are looking for an enthusiastic educator who can make learning about the world around them both meaningful and interactive.

Key Responsibilities & Duties

Develop and implement age-appropriate, curriculum-aligned lesson plans for Primary Social Studies, ensuring alignment with educational standards.

Create dynamic and inclusive classroom environments that encourage critical thinking, discussion, and social interaction among young students.

Assess student progress through formative and summative assessments, providing constructive feedback to parents and students.

Integrate real-world social studies concepts (e.g., community roles, basic geography, cultural awareness) into daily classroom activities.

Collaborate with fellow teachers and administration to support school-wide social studies initiatives and classroom activities.

Maintain accurate records of student performance and participation.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Education: Bachelor of Education (B.Ed) degree in a relevant field.

Experience: 2-5 years of proven teaching experience, preferably in a pre-primary or primary setting.

Knowledge: Strong foundational knowledge of social studies concepts suitable for young learners.

Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, creativity in lesson planning, and the ability to manage a classroom effectively.

Job Scope

The Primary Social Studies Teacher will be responsible for nurturing a love for learning about society and the world in pre-primary students. The expected outcome is that students will develop basic social awareness, respect for diversity, and the ability to engage thoughtfully with their immediate environment. This role requires a proactive, patient, and creative educator committed to creating a positive and stimulating learning experience.

description:
PEP Schoolv2 | Elementary Educator (Grades 1–5)

Full-time | HSR Layout, Whitefield

The opportunity

Most schools in India are built for “the average child.” Everyone moves at the same pace, does the same worksheet, writes the same test, and is judged by the same yardstick.

But children are not average.

PEP Schoolv2 exists because we believe school needs a version 2. A model where learning is genuinely personalized, where children are known deeply, and where teaching is designed around how children actually learn. When you do this well, two things happen together. Children build strong academic foundations and they stay curious. They become confident learners who can explain their thinking, not just produce answers.

We are looking for educators who feel energized by this mission. People who want to redesign school so it fits children, instead of forcing children to fit school.

What you will do

This is not a role where you follow a fixed script. You will teach, design, and improve continuously.

Teach in a way that meets children where they are
• Work with students in a manner that allows you to actually know each child
• Understand each child’s level, confidence, strengths, and gaps
• Adapt your approach so each child progresses with clarity and momentum

Design learning for understanding
• Create lessons that build real concepts, not memorized steps
• Help children explain their reasoning in math, articulate their ideas in writing, and connect ideas across subjects like science and social studies
• Use examples, stories, models, hands-on work, and real-world contexts to make learning stick

Build systems that make personalization possible
• Use observation and simple tracking to see where each child is and what they need next
• Contribute to routines, assessment methods, and classroom culture that help children become independent and responsible
• Share what you learn so good practices spread across PEP Schoolv2

Grow fast as an educator
• Get training and structured feedback
• Collaborate with a team that cares about teaching craft and learning outcomes
• Learn to teach with clarity, warmth, and high standards

Prior Teaching experience is not mandatory

We care more about capability and mindset than job titles. Many excellent educators come from other careers. If you have done well in another field and feel pulled towards education, apply.

A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree is preferred. Engineering backgrounds are welcome.

About PEP Schoolv2

PEP Schoolv2 (www.pepschoolv2.com) is a school network with campuses in Bangalore and Hyderabad, serving children from early years onwards through high school. We call ourselves “v2” because we are intentionally building the next version of school. More personalized, more thoughtful, more rigorous in the ways that matter, and more human.

PEP Schoolv2 is led by a founding team with IIT and IIM backgrounds and experience from places like McKinsey and Amazon. That matters here because we bring high standards and strong systems. We take teaching seriously, we measure what matters, and we improve continuously.

Families choose PEP Schoolv2 because they want both. Strong foundations and a child who stays curious, confident, and capable. We believe great educators are the foundation of great schools, and we compensate accordingly. This is a professional role with competitive pay.

Practical details
• Locations: HSR Layout, Whitefield
• Schedule: Day shift; full-time preferred, part-time options

description:
Job Summary

We are looking for hardworking and responsible Kitchen Staff to support day-to-day kitchen operations at Dil Foods. The role involves food preparation, cooking assistance, maintaining kitchen hygiene, handling raw materials, and ensuring food safety standards are followed.

Key Responsibilities
• Assist in daily food preparation and cooking activities.
• Follow standard recipes, portion sizes, and preparation procedures.
• Wash, cut, clean, and prepare vegetables, meat, and other ingredients as required.
• Maintain cleanliness and hygiene of the kitchen, equipment, utensils, and workstations.
• Follow FIFO/FEFO practices for food and raw-material storage.
• Check the quality and freshness of ingredients before use.
• Properly store raw materials, prepared food, and kitchen supplies.
• Follow food safety, hygiene, and company SOPs at all times.
• Ensure proper handling of food to prevent contamination and wastage.
• Support loading, unloading, and movement of kitchen materials when required.
• Maintain cleanliness of refrigerators, freezers, storage areas, and kitchen equipment.
• Report damaged equipment, food spoilage, pest issues, or hygiene concerns to the supervisor.
• Dispose of kitchen waste properly as per company procedures.
• Support stock counting and inventory-related activities.
• Maintain discipline, punctuality, and professional conduct at the workplace.
• Perform other kitchen-related duties assigned by the supervisor or management.

Required Skills & Qualifications
• Minimum 10th / 12th standard qualification preferred.
• Previous experience in a kitchen, restaurant, cloud kitchen, food manufacturing unit, hotel, or similar environment will be an advantage.
• Freshers can also be considered depending on the requirement.
• Basic knowledge of food preparation and kitchen hygiene.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Good teamwork and communication skills.
• Physically fit and comfortable standing for extended periods.
• Willingness to work in shifts, including weekends and holidays as per business requirements.

Key Competencies
• Food safety and hygiene awareness
• Teamwork
• Discipline and punctuality
• Time management
• Attention to detail
• Ability to follow SOPs
• Cleanliness and personal hygiene
• Willingness to learn

Performance Expectations

The employee is expected to:
• Maintain high standards of personal and kitchen hygiene.
• Follow all food safety and operational SOPs.
• Minimize food wastage and material damage.
• Complete assigned kitchen tasks within the required timelines.
• Maintain proper workplace discipline and attendance.
• Cooperate with supervisors and team members to ensure smooth kitchen operations.

Compensation & Benefits
• Salary: As per company standards and candidate experience
• Statutory benefits: As applicable under company policy and applicable law
• Employee benefits as per company policy.
• Training and opportunities for career growth within the organization.

Note: The above responsibilities are indicative and may be modified based on operational

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:
• Flexible schedule
• Food provided
• Health insurance

Work Location: In person

description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
About the NATS Program

This role is offered under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS), a flagship initiative of the Government of India designed to equip Indian youth with practical, trade-specific skills. Administered under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 (amended in 1973), this program at Volvo Group offers engineering graduates and diploma holders a structured, 1-year practical, hands-on On-the-Job Training (OJT) opportunity to build industry-ready capabilities.

Mission of the role

Support the Customs & Trade India team in improving compliance, reducing risk and making import-export processes simpler, faster and more data driven. This role is designed for a high-potential graduate who combines curiosity with practical judgment, communicates confidently, takes ownership and follows actions through to closure.

What you will do
• Support customs compliance controls, including document checks, broker follow-up, internal controls, post-entry review and closure of identified gaps.
• Maintain customs and trade data, trackers, records and supporting evidence with strong attention to accuracy and deadlines.
• Assist with HS classification research, origin documentation, customs valuation inputs, notifications, licences and trade-policy monitoring under guidance from the team.
• Support matters relating to duty-relief and trade schemes such as bonded operations, EPCG, duty drawback, bank guarantees, preferential trade agreements and other applicable regimes.
• Coordinate with Customs Brokers, logistics service providers, suppliers and internal teams to obtain facts, resolve documentation gaps and move actions forward.
• Support customs audits, assessments, queries and case files by organising evidence, preparing working papers and tracking open points.
• Identify delays, rework and waste in customs processes; propose simple, practical improvements and help implement approved actions.
• Use Excel, Power BI, workflow tools or basic automation to improve visibility, controls and productivity. Prior coding experience is helpful but not mandatory.
• Create clear presentations, process notes and digital learning material for internal customs and trade awareness.
• Learn continuously, ask thoughtful questions, escalate risks early and own assigned deliverables from start to finish

Exposure areas
• HS tariff classification and product understanding
• Preferential trade agreements, origin and trade-policy measures
• Bonded facilities, CKD operations and customs concessions
• Customs valuation, notifications and regulatory documentation
• Import-export process improvement, lead-time and cost optimisation
• Customs broker governance, audits and compliance controls
• Digitalisation, data quality, dashboards and automation

Who you are

You may be early in your career, but you are not passive. You are resourceful, comfortable working through ambiguity and willing to take the first responsible step rather than wait for perfect instructions.
• Graduate in International Business, Supply Chain / Logistics, Law, Business Administration, Economics, Commerce, Customs or a related discipline.
• Custom & Trade Compliance knowledge

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:
Production Engineering Manager Your role and responsibilities

As an Executive Diploma Trainee, you will support business, collaborating with different teams, and contributing to the company's strategic objectives.

Gains knowledge by performing tasks as directed by the program manager /corresponding leader to support ABB's operations.

The work model for the role is: On-site

• Discovers their own interests, gains exposure to different teams/roles, and builds their skills and experience through challenging and impactful assignments.
• Delivers the assigned tasks/projects within the assignment period.

• Must have diploma degree specialization- EEE/ECE/Mechanical from 2026 pass out batch.

• Good communication, interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
• Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and deliver them within defined timelines.
• Basic understanding of documentation, reporting, data handling, quality, and process improvement.
• Demonstrates adaptability, integrity, accountability, and a proactive approach to learning and development.
More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division's technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division's portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world's largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division's ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
